name: Sino Horizon Holdings Limited
summary: Sino Horizon Holdings Limited, established in 1997, is based in Shanghai, China. The company, along with its various subsidiaries, specializes in the development, management, sale, and leasing of property assets across the Chinese market. Its business operations are structured around key divisions, including Real-Estate Sales, Commercial Leasing, Property Management, and other related ventures. The firm boasts a diverse real estate portfolio featuring residential complexes, commercial office spaces, and retail shopping centers. Additionally, Sino Horizon provides comprehensive property administration services, which include the management of parking facilities.
